::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 167,895 people lived in County Tipperary, up 5.2% on 2016. It had the 7th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 39% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Tipperary was €1,078, the 23rd highest of the 26 counties.
:::
